purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The Ministry of Finance directory lists Damanhur real-estate registration. ESA states its historic role in producing ownership maps/registers, and its digital map product workflow is request-based. No anonymous Damanhur parcel vector service or full geometry response was found.
registryAssessment: An official Ministry of Finance directory lists the Damanhur real-estate registration office and a Damanhur registry unit in Beheira. The Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) describes its role in ownership maps and property records and offers digital maps through a written request/quotation/payment process. This confirms local record/map institutions, but not open vector data.
